decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core offer, but naval programs are long-cycle, project-based business where the certification is already sunk, so keeping this low-cost option open while contracts may materialize is reasonable despite thin evidence.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build on core competences and drew follow-on investment such as the LED replacement kit, which shows the option is being exercised rather than abandoned.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product close to the core range and costs little to keep listed, although design task lights face fast portfolio refresh cycles.
The pendant office luminaire sits close to the established offer and is cheap to keep, and office lighting demand after 2020 is still uncertain, so waiting preserves its value.
The premium pendant luminaire is close to the core range with low holding costs, and its prospects in the premium office segment are not yet resolved enough to justify abandoning it.
